task_name: Corner and Cure - Cold-case label system
client_brief:
Cold-case labels and ordering tiles from our cafe's existing materials

Our sign is painted on a board screwed to the wall. Most of the food photographs were taken on a phone over the counter. Corner & Cure needs someone who can work carefully with those materials and turn them into a practical, consistent set.

Final handoff

 Cold-case label: 39 named exports. The allergen wording agrees with the approved item record. The item name is readable at label size.

 Marketplace item tile: 38 named exports. The photograph shows the named item. The restaurant identity does not obscure the dish.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: Sandwiches worth leaving the block for.
brand_identity.sector: A fast casual neighbourhood deli counter with a cold case and a marketplace storefront, on a corner in Brooklyn, New York.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Brooklyn, New York; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Corner & Cure is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Brooklyn, New York, and this commission covers phase 2: counter refit, cold-case labels and signage.
brand_identity.audience: Walk up trade, mostly twenty to forty five, three visits a week, deciding in about eight seconds at the counter or six on a phone. They want appetite and honesty, not polish.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Twelve to sixteen dollars for a sandwich or a bowl. Impulse priced but not cheap: the price is the offer and sits large and proud, while the whole shop works to look like a place that is worth it rather than a bargain or a franchise.
brand_identity.typography: The hand painted board over the slicer stays photographed artwork, never re set as type. Champion Gothic Heavyweight (condensed display) carries item names, prices and specials: on the 1200 px marketplace tiles the price runs 132 px and the item name 84 px, on a 90 mm label the item name is 14 pt and the price 22 pt. Benton Sans Regular (workhorse sans) sets allergen lines 6.5 pt on 9 pt leading, hours and loyalty rules 8 pt. Never set an allergen line in Champion Gothic.
brand_identity.voice: Plainspoken, neighbourhood, a little brash and generous. Example line the brand would write: 'Pulled together, piled high, see you at the counter.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: There is no digital version of the sign: the name survives only as a board hand painted by a sign painter twenty years ago and screwed to the wall over the slicer. Everything else was shot on the owner's phone over the counter. A two page written note holds the voice, hours, loyalty rules and section names, and the label printer holds a press file.
brand_identity.values: A family corner shop, second generation. Real food for regulars, made with the hand of a place, not a chain.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Reconcile records before merge and prove page, row, name, and amount completeness from the delivered artifacts.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
